title: Improving Video Corpus Moment Retrieval with Partial Relevance Enhancement

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract Video Corpus Moment Retrieval (VCMR) is a new video retrieval task aimed at retrieving a relevant moment from a large corpus of untrimmed videos using a text query.

core_problem_transition.summary: The task can be decomposed into two sub-tasks: Video Retrieval (VR), which aims to retrieve the relevant video that potentially contains the target moment using a text query, and Single Video Moment Retrieval (SVMR), which requires localizing the target...

evidence.quote: The task can be decomposed into two sub-tasks: Video Retrieval (VR), which aims to retrieve the relevant video that potentially contains the target moment using a text query, and Single Video Moment Retrieval (SVMR), which requires localizing the target moment semantically related to the query in the retrieved video.

core_problem_transition.summary: This treatment yields a model incapable of prioritizing relevant content, resulting in sub-optimal moment retrieval.
